source: Owner message on 2026-10-29 to the Claude session doing the UDA and Mission Control work, answering an owner-page question that the session's replies had named by number without linking the page.
owner_statement: can you link the questions page whenever you put a question for me? isn't that already in UDA rules? fix that durably
problem: Rule 1 told replies to point to the page, and rule 2 required the file's link only when a session in another account had updated it. Nothing required the link itself whenever a reply asked or mentioned a question, so replies named questions by number and the owner had to find the page himself.
required_behavior: A reply that asks the owner a question, says one was added or changed, or says one is still waiting for him, gives the page's exact link in that same reply, next to the question's number.
The link is the one the owner can open from where he reads: the published view when it is current, otherwise the Git file's link.
The link is checked right before it is given; for a file in a private repository, an authenticated read of that exact file is the check.
basis: Rules 1 and 2 of patterns/owner-questions-page.md before this change, which covered pointing to the page but not linking it in every such reply.
scope: Rule 10 and the status note of patterns/owner-questions-page.md, its LESSON-INDEX.md and docs/INDEX.md entries, this record, and their tests.

origin.owner_outcome: The owner opens the page for any question he is told about in one step, from the reply itself.
origin.notes: Where the link sits in the reply (next to the question's number) is the assistant's choice of placement.

execution_surfaces.surface: patterns/owner-questions-page.md, reached through LESSON-INDEX.md and docs/INDEX.md
The UDA and Mission Control workstream's owner questions page
execution_surfaces.note: The requesting session's turn-end step prints the page's link with the open questions' numbers, so its final answer carries the link.

execution_surfaces.reason: Each workstream's session applies the rule when it next loads this pattern and asks the owner something.

nonclaims: No repository rule can force a session that never loaded UDA.
A link to a private repository opens only for someone signed in with access to it.
